posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
The digital version of Sentinels of the Multiverse is almost here! It's coming out on October 15th.

To celebrate, we're holding simultaneous launch parties in Cleveland and Halifax (we are a company that rises above mere international borders). Each party is being held on October 19th starting at 7 pm Eastern time (that's 8 pm Atlantic in Halifax). There are free drinks, free food, and prizes to be had! And of course you'll get to play the game if you haven't already.

We'll have a video link between the parties so everyone can chat with one another. If there's interest, maybe we can open it up to a generalized Google Hangout or Skype call? Let me know what you think.

To get free stuff you'll need to get a free ticket from the appropriate Eventbrite event. Please only take a ticket if you're really coming!

Cleveland Eventbrite Page

Halifax Eventbrite Page

Hope to see some of you on Sunday!
